{{Quote|What will happen to me now?"<br />"The Council have granted me permission to train you. You will be a Jedi. I promise.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi at the funeral|<ref name="TPM" />}}
The '''funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn''' took place in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], after [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|his]] death at the hands of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" />

Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were in attendance, including [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and several members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Non-Jedi attendees included [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], newly-elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], among several others.<ref name="TPM" /> The events of the [[Jedi funeral/Legends|funeral]] nearly caused Queen Amidala to cancel the [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|victory celebrations]] that had been planned for the following day out of respect for the late [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], but she reconsidered after [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] informed her that Jinn would have wanted her to continue with the celebration.<ref name="SW:EIJ:QA">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref>

[[File:FuneralAttendees_ep1ig.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Attendees of the funeral.]]
The death of Qui-Gon left Anakin feeling depressed. The separation from his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]] and the realization that Padmé was the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] left him feeling insecure about his future direction.<ref name="Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker">''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref><ref name="Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle">''[[Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle]]''</ref> Obi-Wan promised Anakin that he would become a Jedi. Likewise, during the funeral, Windu and Yoda acknowledged that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had indeed returned and began to [[Second Sith theory|speculate]] that there was likely another Sith Lord in adherence with the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], though they were unsure as to whether the Sith who had killed Qui-Gon had been the [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] or the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. Unknown to the two Jedi Masters at the time, however, the Sith Master, Darth Sidious, was present at the funeral under the public persona of Palpatine.<ref name="TPM" />
